## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues.

## Validation

List the exact commands/devices tested and their results. Explain checks you could not run.

## Compatibility and evidence

Describe API, dependency, ABI, or artifact changes where relevant. Include screenshots or a recording for visual changes.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read the contributing guide and kept the change focused.
- [ ] I included reproduction/validation details and relevant regression coverage.
- [ ] Any changed dependency pin is published and fetchable.
- [ ] I did not include ROMs, firmware, BIOS/console keys, credentials, or signing material.
